messages:
dina: FYI CI microbench on PR#19521 failed a threshold diff. p50 for kv-warmup path up ~9% on the kernel_selector path :eyes:
benchbot: [AUTO] microbench pr-19521 summary:
  p50: 2.10ms -> 2.29ms (+9.2%)
  p95: 4.3ms -> 4.83ms (+12.1%)
  artifacts: https://ci.internal/19521/artifacts/bench.html
sam: link looks noisy. can you repro locally with the same image? any quick flamegraphs?
mia: ran on laptop with docker image from the CI, saw ~6-8% p50 bump too. quick grep points at commit 7f4a2c3 (kernel-autoselect heuristic tweak).
leo: that tweak changed cost delta thresholds, could invert preference for small kernels under quant path. worth bisecting on the base.
dina: starting git bisect now. running the microbench harness script to be consistent:
```
./tools/bench/run_microbench --suite=kv-warmup --repeats=7 --image=ci/pr-19521
```
benchbot: re-run requested by dina, queued job: https://ci.internal/queue/48291 
dina: bisect result -> culprit commit = 7f4a2c3 (author: mia). flamegraph pinned hot time to select_kernel_for_seq() — selector doing extra cost scoring per candidate. flamegraph: https://ci.internal/19521/flame.html :thinking:
sam: that selector path was optimized to prefer smaller kernels for short seqs. maybe the cost model edge-case causes extra work in continuous-batching where seqlen distribution skews.
mia: I can reproduce the selector calling cost_model() ~3x more often after the tweak. patch attempted to memoize but missed quantized codepath.
ova: suggest revert to unblock rollout and add targeted perf unit to cover memoization in both float/quant paths. :+1:
sam: prefer to bisect/confirm before revert. can we run a small canary on dedicated pool instead of full revert?
dina: kicked off a 5-node canary with the reverted kernel selector and an equivalent shadow run of the PR. results: 3/5 hosts still show regression on PR build, revert hosts look back to baseline.
mia: ok opening a revert PR with a short note. adding microbench golden in CI to prevent regression slipping.
sam: please include a unit that asserts cost_model() call count per request < 2 for warm path. also add an assertion that p50 doesn't exceed golden + threshold.
dina: revert PR created and merged (PR#19554). revert diff included new perf test and a small memoization fix for quant path. :thumbsup:
benchbot: triggered microbench re-run for the merged revert: https://ci.internal/19554/bench
benchbot: microbench pr-19521 (post-revert): p50 2.12ms (-0.3% vs golden), p95 4.32ms (-0.2%). status: PASS. artifacts: https://ci.internal/19554/artifacts/bench.html
sam: great, rollback landed and CI green. follow-up: add a perf gating check for future kernel selector changes and add a short checklist for PRs touching cost heuristics.
dina: I'll file a short RFC for selector invariants and add the perf unit to the golden suite. closing this thread.
